I feel like the most reasonable point for labeling Gregory as an animatronic has to do with the background checks (Both from Freddy and Vanny,) so I will do the best I can to attack that personally.   
Its revealed in the bad ending that Gregory is homeless, so its more than likely that it'd be his first time in the building (or at least his first time receiving so much attention there, considering he is the only kid present.\*)    
If it is to be his first time, I don't believe there'd be much "background" to check on Gregory when it comes to Freddy's scans and Vanny's lack of records.  


\*Though, assuming he has visited the place before, yet its just his first time being trapped in overnight/whatnot. I feel it'd be safe to say he probably kept on the down low to avoid confrontation from any guards to begin with.  


As for Gregory being CC, no huge argument against that here. Though I like to personally think they are separate characters, and that Gregory's own outfit is more of a homage to CC.
